sourceTitle: Turkey schnitzels with four types of cheese
sourceText:
Turkey schnitzels with four types of cheese
By: Easy cook - Lak...
Published: Wednesday, April 24, 2013 - 6:13am

Ingredients




40g Swiss cheese, cut into cubes
80g Gorgonzola (or other blue cheese), cut into cubes
40g  fontina cheese (or Gouda), cut into cubes
20g Parmesan cheese, grated
100ml milk
¼ tsp pepper
2 tbs olive oil
4 small turkey schnitzels
2 sage leaves, chopped
Parsley leaves, chopped

Preparation

1 Melt cheese cubes and grated Parmesan in milk over low heat, stirring occasionally. When cheese is completely melted, set the sauce aside, season with pepper. 2 In a pan sauté the schnitzels for 3 minutes on both sides over low heat. 3 Pour the cheese sauce over schnitzels, sprinkle with chopped herbs, cover and cook for 5 minutes on low. 4 Serve immediately with rice and green salad.

About

Easy and cheesy dish everyone loves.
